subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps & technical deep-dive scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anjali Desai <anjali@cloudbridge.com>, David Li <david.li@gsi-consulting.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps & technical deep-dive scheduling

Thanks again for taking the time this morning — it was great to align on CloudBridge's marketplace goals and the joint GTM motion. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Use case: make Redwood available to customers via CloudBridge marketplace (managed listing + referral) and explore a bundled offering for enterprise customers.
- Success metrics discussed: listing published in Q2, 3 pilot customers in Q3, and a partner-led demo at the Marketplace Partner Summit.

Next steps
1) Technical deep-dive (60 min) to align SEs on integration work (billing, entitlement, deployment patterns).
2) Procurement/marketplace ops sync (30 min) to confirm listing requirements & DocuSign flow.
3) Share qualification matrix and MAP deck (attached).

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Mar 23: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Mar 24: 09:00–10:00

Anjali — can you confirm who from CloudBridge should join (marketplace PM, partner ops, procurement)? If those times don't work, share a couple of alternatives and we'll coordinate with our SEs.

Attachments: cloudbridge-qualification-matrix.pdf, redwood-partner-MAP.pptx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
https://www.redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery: next steps & technical deep-dive scheduling

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. We'd love to move forward. Attendees from our side: myself (Partner PM), David Li (our integration lead / GSI contact), and I will ask Sanjay from procurement to join the procurement sync if needed.

We can do a 60m technical deep-dive. Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Mar 23: 10:00–11:00 (works for us)
- Tue Mar 23: 16:00–17:00 (alternate)
- Wed Mar 24: 09:00–10:00

We'll also include our GCP Marketplace Ops contact on the invite — they typically want the entitlement/billing flow in the tech call. Attaching a short marketplace overview for context.

Attachment: cloudbridge-marketplace-overview.pdf

Best,

anjali@cloudbridge.com

Thanks — Laura here (Solutions Engineering). Tue Mar 23 10:00–11:00 PT works for me. Suggested 60m agenda:
- 0–5m: introductions & goals
- 5–20m: CloudBridge marketplace requirements (ops/procurement speaks)
- 20–45m: integration surface & deployment patterns (billing, entitlements, tokens, support model)
- 45–60m: open technical Q&A + next steps / owners

Pre-reqs from CloudBridge to make the call productive:
- Sandbox/project ID or test account for entitlement checks
- Expected peak qps / typical prompt sizes (tps/seq len) and any rate-limits we should plan for
- Any security/compliance docs you can share ahead of time (SOC2 or checklist)

I'll attach a short tech checklist with the items we usually review.

Attachment: tech-checklist.txt

Laura Bennett
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:20:00 -0700

Thanks everyone — Tue Mar 23 10:00–11:00 PT is good. I'll add the following from CloudBridge:
- Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudbridge.com> (procurement)
- Ravi Kumar <ravi.kumar@cloudbridge.com> (GCP Marketplace Ops)
- David Li (GSI integration lead)

Quick answers to Laura's pre-reqs:
- We'll create a sandbox project and share the test project ID 48 hours before the call.
- Expected pilot load: 2–5 qps; peak ~10 qps for short bursts, average prompt length ~120 tokens.
- I'll share SOC2 summary and our standard marketplace entitlements doc ahead of the call.

Marketplace listing: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/product/cloudbridge/marketplace-listing-id
Attachment: cloudbridge-marketplace-overview.pdf

— Anjali
